subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate spelling that can correctly substitute the misspelt underlined segment in the given sentence.

Who will __adjuddicate__ on this matter?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Adjudicate' **is the correctly spelled word. It means to make a formal judgment or decision about a problem or a disputed matter.

 
 
• **Example:** The council will adjudicate on the planning application at its next meeting.
 
 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is- Option 4: '**Adjudicate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Addjudicate' (Option 1), 'Adjjudicate' (Option 2), and 'Adjudiccate' (Option 3) are mis-spelled and do not exist in English.
